description:
How can doctors participate in one of the world's most horrifying human rights abuses? A new report reveals how the Chinese Communist Party controls China's medical system, creating a system where loyalty to the Party can matter more than the lives of patients. We look at the allegations of forced organ harvesting and why doctors may be afraid to speak out.
